dialogue.text: Ten seconds. Same as the florist.
[warm, slower] That gets her back to fifty-nine in the red, and that's when Gloria speaks up.
Wait, there's a switch? You knew all day?
You asked how to get it back. You never asked how to stop it.

[warm, slower] Since 2010, a bank can only charge you an overdraft fee at an ATM or on an everyday debit card purchase if you said yes to it first. Jess said yes the day she opened her account, with one tiny checkbox buried in a stack of forms.
Open your banking app and look in your debit card settings. It's usually called something like debit card coverage.
